name: Tafalla (Spain)
description: White field with a red ragged saltire (Burgundy cross), charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Tafalla (a castle on blue within a bordure of the chains of Navarre).
history: The flag of Tafalla is formed of a rectangular cloth of proportion 2/3, white, with the red Burgundy cross and the arms of the city in their tinctures at the centre.

features.role: Tafalla arms — castle on blue within a bordure of the chains of Navarre
chains, castle and crown of the arms
